pairs: “You shall not accept a lying voice.
nec junges manum tuam ut pro impio dicas falsum testimonium.
Neither shall you join your hand so as to give false testimony on behalf of the impious.
Non sequeris turbam ad faciendum malum:
You shall not follow the crowd in doing evil.
Neither shall you go astray in judgment,
by agreeing with the majority opinion,
Pauperis quoque non misereberis in judicio.
Likewise, you shall not show pity in judgment of the poor.
If you come across an ox or a donkey of your enemy,
Si videris asinum odientis te jacere sub onere,
If you see the donkey of one who hates you,
you shall not pass by without lifting it up with him.
You shall not deviate in judgment of the poor.
The innocent and the just you shall not kill.
and subvert the words of the just.
You shall not harass a sojourner,
for you know the life of a newcomer.
quia et ipsi peregrini fuistis in terra Ægypti.
For you yourselves also were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
you shall sow your land and gather its produce.
you shall release it and cause it to rest,
so that the poor of your people may eat.
let the beasts of the field eat it.
ita facies in vinea et in oliveto tuo.
So shall you do with your vineyard and your olive grove.
so that your ox and your donkey may rest,
and so that the newcomer and the son of your handmaid may be refreshed.
Preserve all that I have said to you.
Et per nomen externorum deorum non jurabitis,
And by the names of foreign gods you shall not swear;
neither shall these be heard from your mouth.
Tribus vicibus per singulos annos mihi festa celebrabitis.
Three times in each year, you shall celebrate feasts to me.
You shall keep the solemnity of unleavened bread.
For seven days you shall eat unleavened bread,
at the time of the month of new grain,
non apparebis in conspectu meo vacuus.
You shall not appear empty-handed in my sight,
Et solemnitatem messis primitivorum operis tui,
for it is the solemnity of the harvest of the first-fruits of your work,
of whatever you have sown in the field.
Likewise, it is a solemnity at the end of the season,
quando congregaveris omnes fruges tuas de agro.
when you will have gathered in all your crops from the field.
Ter in anno apparebit omne masculinum tuum coram Domino Deo tuo.
Three times a year, all your males shall appear before the Lord your God.
Non immolabis super fermento sanguinem victimæ meæ,
You shall not immolate the blood of my victim over leaven,
nec remanebit adeps solemnitatis meæ usque mane.
nor shall the fat of my solemnity remain until morning.
Primitias frugum terræ tuæ deferes in domum Domini Dei tui.
You shall carry the first grain of the land to the house of the Lord your God.
Non coques hædum in lacte matris suæ.
You shall not cook a young goat in the milk of its mother.
Behold, I will send my Angel,
and preserve you on your journey,
et introducat in locum quem paravi.
and lead you into the place that I have prepared.
and do not hold him in disregard.
For he will not release you when you have sinned,
et est nomen meum in illo.
and my name is in him.
But if you listen to his voice
and do all that I say,
I will be an enemy to your enemies,
and I will afflict those who afflict you.
And my Angel will go before you,
and he will bring you to the Amorite,
You shall not adore their gods,
You shall not do their works,
And you shall serve the Lord your God,
ut benedicam panibus tuis et aquis,
so that I may bless your bread and your waters,
et auferam infirmitatem de medio tui.
and so that I may take away sickness from your midst.
or barren ones in your land.
I will fill up the number of your days.
Terrorem meum mittam in præcursum tuum,
I will send my terror to run ahead of you,
et occidam omnem populum, ad quem ingredieris:
and I will kill all the people to whom you will enter.
cunctorumque inimicorum tuorum coram te terga vertam:
And I will turn the backs of all your enemies before you,
so that they will put to flight the Hivite,
Non ejiciam eos a facie tua anno uno:
I will not cast them out from your face in one year,
lest the land be reduced to a wilderness
and the wild beasts increase against you.
Paulatim expellam eos de conspectu tuo,
I will expel them little by little from your sight,
Ponam autem terminos tuos a mari Rubro usque ad mare Palæstinorum,
Then I will set your limits to be from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Palestinians,
et a deserto usque ad fluvium:
and from the desert all the way to the river.
tradam in manibus vestris habitatores terræ,
I will deliver into your hands the inhabitants of the land,
et ejiciam eos de conspectu vestro.
and I will cast them out from your sight.
You shall not enter into a pact with them,
They may not live on your land,
ne forte peccare te faciant in me,
lest perhaps they may cause you to sin against me,
quod tibi certe erit in scandalum.
which certainly would be a temptation for you.”
